# Moon 0.4.11 beta
A calmer workspace for your tabs.
- Open a native assistant workspace from the Codex sidebar button. Choose between Codex and Gemini. - Share specific website tabs for reading, comparison, and approved page interaction. Private tabs, cookies, passwords, and unshared sites are excluded. - Codex uses the official local CLI and a separate ChatGPT sign-in. Gemini uses a Google AI Studio key saved locally in Keychain. - A compact composer, formatted chat responses, code copying, and expandable browser actions keep the assistant native to Moon. - Codex receives only its generated connection folder through macOS; it no longer scans Moon’s protected app data. - Read ready pages without waiting for all their images. Preserve icon-font names during translation and avoid repeated cross-origin focus probes. - Hold Option–Space for Nebula’s compact listening strip, then release to act. - Fix the stray blue focus square in the sidebar when opening Settings, while preserving close-button hit targets and selection.
Apple silicon, macOS 26 or later. One signed DMG serves installation and in-app updates. This Moon beta is Apple Development signed and is not Apple-notarized. The optional ActivityWatch companion is distributed separately by its authors.
